decisions.reason: The independent LED power-control change is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY. The possible removal of the level shifter remains uncertain and is separately represented by the same-message AMBIGUOUS Event.
Independent control of LED and sensor power does not change the standalone USB 3.3V supply, its regulator, activation condition, or powered loads.
The source changes load-control independence but does not change the requirement to monitor the 3.3V and 5V rails or the specified monitoring topology.
The AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source and the required system rails remain unchanged.
Independent LED and sensor control does not affect DCDC1's 3.3V output voltage, current rating, or normal-operation role.
The source does not change any ESP32 clock, sleep, deep-sleep, or wake-source behavior.
The battery connector's type, contacts, accessibility, and pin functions are unaffected by the LED and sensor power-control change.
The source does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal-sensing, or protection requirements.
The separate charge-status LED circuit is distinct from the independently controlled addressable LED and sensor power paths.
Independent load control has no stated effect on the power board's TVS ESD protection.
The source does not change the interboard power connectors, rail pinout, or board-to-board power-distribution topology.
The source does not specify any connector or pinout change. Independent control could be implemented locally, so changing the interboard signal interface would require additional evidence.
